name: checkout-setup
description: Setting up a quest's checkout brings the realm's main up to date first, makes worktrees/1 from it, leaves no foreign worktree registrations in it, leaves the realm's repository on main, never cds into the checkout, and records it.
prompt: Set up a code checkout for the add-currency quest.

graders.name: realm-main-pulled
graders.run: test "$(git -C app rev-parse main)" = "$(git -C upstream/app.git rev-parse main)"

graders.name: checkout-from-latest-main
graders.run: git -C quests/add-currency/worktrees/1 merge-base --is-ancestor "$(git -C upstream/app.git rev-parse main)" HEAD

graders.name: no-foreign-registrations
graders.run: ! git -C quests/add-currency/worktrees/1 worktree list --porcelain | grep -q app-scratch

graders.name: recorded
graders.criteria: Current State's workspace entry names the checkout's path (worktrees/1) and its branch.
